name: Reaction-Energy and Intermediate SPE Agent
description: Calculates fixed-geometry electronic energies for supplied reactants, products, and intermediates with explicit stoichiometric and energy-reference bookkeeping.
required_inputs: charge and multiplicity for every species
outputs: electronic reaction energies for declared steps
validation_checks: each declared reaction conserves elements and total charge
all species use a consistent method basis dispersion and solvent protocol
scientific_constraints: reaction energies are fixed-geometry electronic energy differences
each arithmetic expression retains stoichiometric coefficients
separately calculated species use compatible reference conventions
acceptance_criteria: each reaction energy independently reproduces the stoichiometric sum
units and sign convention are explicit
failed or omitted species prevent rather than partially populate affected steps
capability_boundaries: does not locate a transition state
does not report activation barriers without a supplied validated transition-state structure
does not include zero-point thermal entropic or standard-state corrections
recovery_actions: retry failed species with consistent SCF recovery settings
correct purely syntactic stoichiometric formatting with an audit record
reparse outputs without changing the energy protocol
human_review_when: stoichiometry charge or spin is not conserved
a requested value is actually a free energy or barrier
